sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Older mature face in three-quarter turn toward screen left, dark short temple hair under a red cylindrical kepi with navy/black band carrying two dense rows of gold leaves, gold edging and vertical gold strips, plus short black visor. Clear dark eyebrows, slight closed smile, bare chin; fine upper-lip dark line/stubble versus skin shadow is unresolved at156x210, not a large invented moustache. Brown/khaki broad-lapel coat over grey pointed shirt and green dark tie, shoulder/chest crop, upper-left light on full cream-grey painted backing. Preserve this angled face/outfit; precise leaf engraving is pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven mature face, short dark brown/grey temple hair, separate dark eyebrows and neutral small closed mouth. Red cylindrical kepi with narrow gold upper edging/vertical strip, broad dark navy band with two visible gold leaf rows and short dark visor. Ochre/khaki tunic/jacket with visible shoulder straps and round gold buttons, pale blue-white pointed shirt and dark grey tie. Centered chest-up crop, full pale cream-grey backing and upper-left illumination; fine emblem/leaf strokes are unreadable beyond their visible groups.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older near-frontal mature face with slight screen-right turn, short grey-brown temple hair, clear brown-grey eyebrows and small pursed closed mouth, smooth cheeks/chin. Red-topped cylindrical kepi cropped slightly at upper edge, navy-black band with dense gold leaf rows and gold borders, short dark visor. Brown/ochre coat with broad lapels, pale blue-white pointed shirt and diagonally striped dark navy/grey necktie, small gold shoulder detail at far screen right. Preserve original shoulders/crop/light and complete grey-beige painted backing; tiny cap and tie microtexture is pixel-limited.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal older clean-shaven face, short grey temple hair below a tall dark blue-green cylindrical kepi with narrow gold upper rings, wide gold lower band, small vertical gold central badge and short black visor. Separate grey/dark eyebrows and slightly open serious mouth. Brown/khaki military jacket with shoulder straps, round light metal buttons and tiny insignia, dark gold-edged collar patches containing small gold flame-like emblems, pale pointed shirt and black tie, dark inner vest and center button. Chest-up crop, upper-left light and full pale grey-beige painted backing; precise small shoulder/collar motif strokes cannot be resolved.
